oliver: Observed a subtle quality regress for v5-lite int4 during canary. Notable: high-confidence queries still ok but mid-confidence cohort (conf 0.45-0.7) shows score calibration shift -> 3.9% hit-rate drop. Canary at 6%.
hema: link: https://dash.internal/redwood/onboard/v5-lite/int4  looks like calibration curve shifted; reliability for mid-confidence buckets degraded.
kai: any latency wins? yes p95 -12ms. But UX impact on mid-conf requests is concerning.
oliver: proposal: introduce "confidence-weighted routing": instead of binary route, weight-split by request.confidence; requests with conf<0.45 -> quant, conf>0.7 -> fp32, mid -> fractional route (70% fp32, 30% quant) AND require calibration_delta < 0.02 for promote.
hema: also add a thermostat: if mid-cohort hit-rate_delta > 0.03 for 20m then shrink canary by 50% and enable 100% shadowing for mid cohort.
kai: quick rollout snippet (policy entry):
```
rule: conf_weighted_holdback
match: cohort == "mid_conf"
action: fractional_route {"fp32":0.7, "quant":0.3}
promote_condition: calibration_delta <= 0.02
thermostat: {"metric":"hit_rate_delta","threshold":0.03,"window_mins":20}
```

sre-bot: created monitor MON_CONF_1745009999 and set pager thresholds.
rollout-bot: queued: adjust-canary v5-lite int4 -> canary:2%, conf_weighted_holdback:active, shadow_mid:100% (2h).
hema: i'll own 12h watch and add mid_conf to nightly eval. kai please add calibration curve plot to the dashboard.
oliver: thanks team. we'll re-evaluate in 6h; immediate rollback plan: full revert to v5-stable if thermostat trips twice.
kai: noted. posting traces to ticket now. :thumbsup:
